resources.string: Choose an app for the %1$s button
Choose an app for the gallery button
Choose an app for the messages button
Lets HALauncher lock your screen when you double-tap an empty area of the home screen. It can\'t read your screen, wipe data or change your password.
HALauncher uses this only to lock the screen when you double-tap the home screen. It can\'t read your screen or change anything else.
To lock your phone by double-tapping the home screen, let HALauncher lock the screen on the next dialog. It\'s used only to lock the screen — it can\'t read your screen or change anything else.

Freeze every setting so nothing changes by accident. While on, the other settings are greyed out, the gallery, messages and payments buttons can\'t be changed, and long-pressing the app sphere won\'t open its editor. Turn this off to make changes again.

Double-tap an empty part of the home screen to lock your phone. Turning this on asks you to let HALauncher lock the screen; it\'s used only for that — it can\'t read your screen or change anything else. Turning it off removes that access.
Which category search starts on each time you open it. \"All\" searches everything.

Leave files you\'d never open out of search — app backups, caches and the trash bin — so the index stays small and the app lighter. No extra permission: it works within the file access you\'ve already granted.
How strong the tick feels as you turn the app sphere, switch search categories and pull search in. Slide to Off for no vibration.
Set HALauncher as your home screen and manage the contacts and files permissions. Grant anything you skipped, or that was turned off elsewhere.
A quick guide to the swipes, long-presses and buttons that get around the launcher.
A couple of quick things so the launcher works its best. You can set these up now or later — open \"Set-up & permissions\" in settings any time.
Set HALauncher as your default home app so it opens whenever you press the Home button.
Let HALauncher read your contacts so you can search for people, then call or message them. It only reads them to search — nothing leaves your phone.
Give HALauncher file access so your documents, photos and downloads turn up in search.
Swipe up anywhere on the home screen to search your apps, contacts and files. Swipe back down to close it.
While searching, swipe left or right to move between All, Apps, Contacts and Files.
Long-press an empty part of the home screen to open the launcher settings.
Drag the sphere on the right up or down to spin through your pinned apps, then tap one to open it.
Long-press the sphere to choose which apps are pinned and to reorder them.
Tap the camera, gallery, phone, messages, payments or internet buttons to open them straight away.
Long-press the gallery, messages or payments button to pick which app it opens, or to change it later.
Tap the time to open your alarms, and the date to open your calendar.
Turn on \"Double-tap to lock\" in settings, then double-tap an empty spot to lock your phone.
